thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: CapacityExhaustionHandler (pager id PG-4832) -- queue length on inference-worker queue > 110k and average dequeue rate dropping below threshold. Autoscales not adding nodes.

pagerduty: PG-4832 paging eng-oncall rotation (severity: P2)

Alex P.: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs.

Priya M.: I'm here, seeing a bunch of "scale request accepted" then "scale failed: quota_exceeded" in the scaler logs. Looks like cloud node quota is at limit for the region.

Jamal R.: Confirmed. Autoscaler tried to request +12 nodes around 03:42 UTC, provider returned 403 quota error. Queue shows backlog ~120k, median latency spiked from 120ms -> 2.1s.

Alex P.: past 5m enqueue rate: 1800 req/s, processing capacity ~600 req/s. Autoscaler target would have been +10 workers.

Priya M.: Past hour there were several rolling jobs that consumed ephemeral GPUs; quota consumed. I'm seeing nodepool scale events:
```
[2026-03-14T03:42:12Z] autoscaler.request: desired=+12, provider_response={"error":"quotaExceeded","details":"GPUS quota reached for region-us-west1"}
[2026-03-14T03:42:13Z] autoscaler.retry
[2026-03-14T03:44:01Z] autoscaler.giveup: reason=quota_exceeded
```

Sasha T.: tagging cloud-ops and infra now. We may need an emergency quota bump or to re-route low-priority traffic.

Jamal R.: Two mitigation paths: emergency manual node add (if cloud-ops can force quota) OR reduce pressure by draining lower-priority prefixes and switching some routes to smaller model variants. Can also enable temporary shedding for non-enterprise customers.

Alex P.: I'm going to manually scale the inference-worker deployment as an immediate stopgap (we have a small spare pool in another region we can use via cross-region autoscale). Priya, can you run the drain plan?

Priya M.: running manual scale now:
```bash
# scale worker replicas up to 40 to absorb backlog (short term)
kubectl -n inference scale deploy inference-worker --replicas=40
# patch route to prefer small-model for 'public' tag
redwoodctl route update --route public-seq --fallback small-quantized-v2
```

Priya M.: kubectl response: deployment.apps/inference-worker scaled

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PG-4832 acknowledged by Alex P.

pagerduty: PG-4832 escalated to SRE lead after 15m with no healthy scaling action recorded.

Sasha T.: Cloud-ops responded: quota increase request submitted to provider, estimate 18-36m for quota to be approved. They offered to temporarily spin a reserved pool in us-west2 which requires manual network peering (we can ripen in ~7m).

Alex P.: While waiting for provider, I turned on fallback routing for bulk requests and reduced batching window for small customers. Command and config:
```json
{"route":"public-seq","fallback":"small-quantized-v2","batch_window_ms":10}
```

Jamal R.: That reduced median latency for non-critical traffic from 2.1s -> 350ms and started draining backlog slowly.

Priya M.: I'm seeing worker side errors reduce. Backlog dropped from 120k -> 48k in 9m after scale + fallback. Throughput up to ~850 req/s.

Diana (oncall): Noting customer impact: Hosted API saw elevated latencies and a 0.9% 5xx spike during the peak window. Two enterprise customers on Dedicated had degraded tail latency but no hard errors (they're on pinned fleets). I've opened an incident status update for affected customers.

Alex P.: PD note: manual mitigations in place; cloud quota bump pending. Will handoff to SRE for post incident followup.

Sasha T.: Cloud-ops confirmed temporary pool creation completed at 03:54 UTC, we attached nodes to inference autopool and autoscaler resumed normal behavior.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PG-4832: status=resolved (auto-resolve triggered after metrics returned to baseline)

Priya M.: final numbers: peak backlog 124,102, peak enqueue rate 1.9k r/s, peak processing 920 r/s after manual scale, customer 5xx delta +0.9%. Resolution achieved by: manual scale + fallback routing + provider temp pool.

Jamal R.: action items:
- emergency quota runbook: owner Sasha T. (create steps for emergency reserve pool and peering)
- autoscaler should detect quota rejections and fall back to cross-region pool automatically: owner Alex P.
- route priority policies: allow automated shedding for non-enterprise traffic at 75k queue threshold: owner Priya M.
- customer comms draft: Diana

Diana (oncall): assigning postmortem owner: Diana. ETA for initial incident writeup 24h. Will include TL;DR, timeline, mitigation, and follow-up actions.

Alex P.: thanks team. leaving handoff to Sasha for infra follow-up. :thumbsup:

Sasha T.: taking over infra follow-up. Marking thread for postmortem.

Priya M.: thumbs up. I'll add the exact commands to the runbook and attach logs.

incident-bot: Reaction: :white_check_mark: PG-4832 resolved and incident channel archived.
